key_decisions: THE REDESIGN, part 1 - SEND TO COMPOSITE (user, 2026-08-04). Right-clicking the canvas offers "Send to Composite", exactly as the Video workspace offers Set as start frame / Set as end frame. It fills the image slot for BOTH Mask Comp and Paint Comp. Copy image POPS OUT of the history context menu - it was only ever the slot's source, and the canvas gesture is the better one because the image you want underneath is usually the one you are looking at.

THE REDESIGN, part 2 - NO MASK SLOT (user, 2026-08-04). Forget a separate place to paste a mask. Mask Comp uses THE MASK OF THE CURRENTLY SELECTED IMAGE: that region is removed from the top image and reveals whatever is in the composite slot underneath. This is strictly better - the user already has a full mask toolkit (brush, detect, points, text, shapes, adjust) pointed at that exact layer, and the pasted-mask slot was a second, worse way to produce the same thing.

WHAT THE REDESIGN DOES NOT TOUCH. The scratch cut layer, the inverted brush meaning, the no-scratch-buffer reveal, the cover-fit contract on both ends, the announce rule, the preview contract wiring, and the server route all stand. Paint Comp is unchanged and WORKS.

COMPOSITE IS A CANVAS MODE, not a flag (drift from the plan, which said to arm it like shapeMode). The gizmo can be a flag BECAUSE it is not a brush and never competes for the pointer; the cut brush needs its own ownership, which is what activeMode decides. CANVAS_MODES in MpiCanvasViewer and _viewerModeFor in the Block must BOTH know it - MPI-375 shipped a dead tool by missing one of those two.

THE CUT GETS ITS OWN SCRATCH LAYER (user, 2026-08-04). Painting it into MaskManager's layers was the cheap option and was rejected: the mask persists per entry, so a composite would eat a mask brushed for an inpaint. NOTE the redesign now READS that mask - reading is fine, it is writing into it that was ruled out.

THE SERVER WAS CHANGED, one line, deliberately: compositeThroughMask resized the overlay with fit: fill, so a mismatched pair stretched on disk while the canvas showed the agreed centre-crop. Now fit: cover, position: centre. Identical to fill whenever the aspects match. One test asserts both ends together - do not "simplify" either half.

_modeKeepsPromptBox MUST NOT delegate to _isCanvasTool. Composite is the one group in the taxonomy that DROPS the PromptBox, and _isCanvasTool now covers all three families. A test guards it; the shortcut is the obvious-looking edit that breaks it.
constraints: THE OPEN BUG - Apply never enables. `_syncApply` sets `ready = !!imageSlot.el.getValue() && !!viewer.el.hasCompositeHole?.()`. Both slots render their thumbnail, so `getValue()` is truthy, which points the finger at `hasCompositeHole()` -> `!comp.isEmpty()` returning false even though a mask was pasted. The whole chain was re-read and IS present: el.setCompositeHole / el.hasCompositeHole / el.getCompositeURL on the viewer, and setCompositeHoleFromDataURL / hasCompositeHole / getCompositeURL in the MpiCanvas _methods allowlist. So the wiring is not the hole. Instrument `CompositeManager.setHoleFromDataURL` and `isEmpty` before changing anything.

LEAD 1 - THE MASK SLOT SWALLOWS ITS OWN FAILURE. In MpiToolOptionsComposite the IMAGE slot rolls back on failure (`if (url && !ok) imageSlot.el.clear()`), but the MASK slot IGNORES the return value entirely (`if (url) await viewer.el.setCompositeHole?.(url)`). `setHoleFromDataURL` resolves FALSE on `img.onerror` and says nothing. So a mask that fails to decode leaves the slot showing a thumbnail (the slot renders the URL itself, independently of whether the canvas accepted it) while the hole stays empty and Apply stays disabled - with no error anywhere. That is exactly the reported symptom. Fix the asymmetry regardless of whether it is the cause.

LEAD 2 - THE CLIENT CUTS BY ALPHA, THE SERVER CUTS BY LUMINANCE, and nothing reconciles them. `_renderOverlay` clips the underlay with `destination-in` against `holeCanvas`, which keeps whatever has ALPHA; `compositeThroughMask` flattens onto black and greyscales, which keeps whatever is WHITE. A mask exported as opaque black-and-white therefore reads as "cut everywhere" on the canvas and "cut only in the white part" on the server, while a mask exported as white-plus-transparent reads correctly on both. Which one `getMaskDataURLForEntry` returns decides whether this is a real defect - CHECK IT, because it also decides whether `isEmpty()` can ever be true for a pasted mask. The redesign (reading the selected entry mask directly) must answer the same question.

THE ANNOUNCE RULE IS LOAD-BEARING AND IT SHIPPED BROKEN ONCE. Every path that changes the cut must call _onCompositeChange - loadImage, clearComposite, setCompositeHoleFromDataURL, _applyUndo, and the end of a cut stroke. A panel that is not told keeps Apply enabled over a hole that no longer exists, and the press returns silently at its own null guard with NO error anywhere. The redesign adds a path (the entry mask changing), so it must announce too.

A CLASS CARRYING `display` OUTRANKS `[hidden] { display: none }`. This bit MPI-382 (inert slider rows) and it bit this card (both media slots rendered thumbnail AND empty state at once) despite two comments warning about it in the very same files. When a component toggles `hidden`, add the explicit `[hidden] { display: none }` rule.
SERVER-SIDE CHANGES NEED A RESTART, NOT A RELOAD. services/ and routes/ are main-process code. services/imageComposite.js changed in this card.

THE WORKING TREE IS CRLF. Anchor source-scraping regexes on `;\r?\n` and give generous {0,N} bounds - a bound that was fine before someone added a comment silently stops matching, which reads as "the method was renamed". Both cost a red test in this session.

BACKTICKS DIE IN A DOUBLE-QUOTED SHELL STRING - in `git commit -m` and in `node -e "..."` alike. Bash command-substitutes them, the words vanish, and the command still SUCCEEDS. Use a heredoc or a script file.

Tests run as `node --test "tests/*.test.cjs"` with the quoted glob. 386/0 at handoff (374 at plan time). The board validator does NOT exist in this repo - a memory hook says to judge its delta, but there is no validate_board.py under .agents/ or the skills tree; do not report a pass from it.
